text: Did you know you've been chewing almost the same rubber as a tire your whole life?
sayTts: [mischievously] Did you know you've been chewing... almost the same rubber as a tire your whole life?

text: Relax. Today I'll show you how it's made.
sayTts: [playfully] Relax. Today I'll show you how it's made.

text: Tire rubber, a giant mixer, 50 degrees… and a fourth step that gives it protection.
say: Tire rubber, a giant mixer, fifty degrees… and a fourth step that gives it protection.
sayTts: [curious] Tire rubber, a giant mixer, fifty degrees... and a fourth step [chuckles] that gives it protection.

text: Gum is rubber you chew, but never swallow.
sayTts: [chuckles] Gum is rubber you chew... but never swallow.

text: But what is it made of?
sayTts: [curious] But what is it made of?

text: The Maya chewed the sap of a tree: the sapodilla.
sayTts: [thoughtful] The Maya chewed the sap of a tree: the sapodilla.

text: Today it's butyl rubber, like a tire's inner tube.
sayTts: [amazed] Today it's butyl rubber, like a tire's inner tube!

text: Its chains tangle like spaghetti. That's why it stretches.
sayTts: [dramatic] Its chains tangle like spaghetti. That's why it stretches.

text: Step one: the gum base melts in the mixer.
sayTts: [dramatic] Step one: the gum base melts in the mixer.

text: Sugar, syrup and flavor: five to fifteen minutes of mixing.
sayTts: [excited] Sugar, syrup and flavor: five to fifteen minutes of mixing!

text: One of the few things that goes in hard… and comes out soft.
sayTts: [mischievously] One of the few things that goes in hard... [chuckles] and comes out soft.

text: Step two: an extruder pushes it out at about 50 degrees Celsius, and rollers flatten it.
say: Step two: an extruder pushes it out at about fifty degrees Celsius, and rollers flatten it.
sayTts: [dramatic] Step two: an extruder pushes it out at about fifty degrees Celsius, and rollers flatten it.

text: Step three: it's cut and left to cool.
sayTts: [thoughtful] Step three: it's cut... and left to cool.

text: Look at what someone commented:

comment.question: If I swallow it, does it stay inside me for seven years?

sayTts: [playfully] Look at what someone commented:

text: If I swallow it, does it stay inside me for seven years?

comment.question: If I swallow it, does it stay inside me for seven years?

sayTts: [sarcastic] If I swallow it, does it stay inside me for seven years?

text: Myth. It passes in a few days, almost whole.
sayTts: [laughs] Myth. It passes in a few days... almost whole.

text: Step four: coating. Spinning drums add syrup, layer by layer.
sayTts: [excited] Step four: coating! Spinning drums add syrup, layer by layer.

text: Like painting a wall: lots of thin coats.
sayTts: [thoughtful] Like painting a wall: lots of thin coats.

text: Careful: if the air goes over 8 percent humidity, the shell gets sticky.
say: Careful: if the air goes over eight percent humidity, the shell gets sticky.
sayTts: [whispers] Careful: if the air goes over eight percent humidity... the shell gets sticky.

text: In the end, the shell is a third of the gum's weight.
sayTts: [gasps] In the end, the shell is... a third of the gum's weight!

text: Before: tree sap. Now: a coated piece with your friend's name on it.
sayTts: [excited] Before: tree sap. Now: a coated piece with your friend's name on it!

text: Tag or send this video to your friend who never lets go of their rubber.
sayTts: [mischievously] Tag or send this video to your friend who never lets go... of their rubber.

text: See you next time! Hit like and follow for more breakdowns like this.
sayTts: [warmly] See you next time! Hit like and follow for more breakdowns like this.
